runs.cmd: echo "Server artifacts: no packaging configured yet."
timeout 120 docker run --rm -e AGOS_ENV=development -e RENDER=true agos:r040-smoke > "$LOG.render" 2>&1; rc2=$?
{ [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 124 ]; } || { echo "FAIL: container without credentials did not refuse to start"; exit 1; }
grep -q "production start refused: no credentials configured" "$LOG" || { echo "FAIL: refusal reason missing"; exit 1; }
{ [ "$rc2" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc2" -ne 124 ]; } || { echo "FAIL: AGOS_ENV=development accepted with RENDER=true"; exit 1; }
grep -q "not allowed on a deployed platform" "$LOG.render" || { echo "FAIL: platform refusal reason missing"; exit 1; }
echo "PASS: production container refuses to start without credentials; development refused on RENDER=true" | tee -a "$LOG"
if ! docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' agos-r040 | grep -q true; then
echo "container exited before answering; rc=container-failure" | tee -a "$LOG"
grep -q '"status"' /tmp/health_body.json || { echo "FAIL: /health body is not health JSON"; cat /tmp/health_body.json; exit 1; }
echo "PASS: /health returned 200 with health JSON" | tee -a "$LOG"
[ "$uid" != "0" ] || { echo "FAIL: container runs as root" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
[ "$code" = "401" ] || { echo "FAIL: anonymous task submission not refused" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
[ "$code" = "401" ] || { echo "FAIL: anonymous task listing not refused" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
echo "open_mode_test_runner:" | tee -a "$LOG"; cat /tmp/task.json | tee -a "$LOG"; echo | tee -a "$LOG"
grep -q 'disabled in open mode' /tmp/task.json || { echo "FAIL: open-mode code execution not refused" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; }
echo "PASS: non-root container; anonymous access refused (401); open-mode code execution refused" | tee -a "$LOG"
python -m pip install pip==26.2.1  # R-148: pinned (was a floating upgrade)
pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.lock  # httpx2: starlette.testclient, needed at collection
echo "PyPI publish disabled by R-030 (policy pending)."
python -m pip install pip==26.2.1  # R-148: pinned (was a floating upgrade)
python -m pip install pip==26.2.1  # R-148: pinned (was a floating upgrade)
python -m pip install pip==26.2.1  # R-148: pinned (was a floating upgrade)
python -m pip install pip==26.2.1  # R-148: pinned (was a floating upgrade)
echo "::error::Atomic batch rule violated: these mandatory docs must be updated in the same PR: ${MISSING[*]}"
|| { echo "::error::Code changed without evidence in docs/audit/"; exit 1; }
